title: Data → Model → Prediction — A Pipeline Becomes a Directed Map
key_insight: Represent the work as a directed acyclic graph: arrows show dependency, and no path loops back forever. A scheduler can run independent branches together.
body:
## A Pipeline Becomes a Directed Map

A large system branches: one cleaned table feeds several models, and one feature is reused in many places. A simple straight line no longer describes it.

Represent the work as a directed acyclic graph: arrows show dependency, and no path loops back forever. A scheduler can run independent branches together.

Cache a step only when its inputs and code version match. This makes partial reruns safe and gives every prediction a record of the exact artifacts that produced it.
common_mistakes: Changing serving-time cleaning without retraining the model.
Saving the model but not its learned preprocessing.
Running a pipeline without recording versions or data-quality counts.
mini_exercise: Draw the situation from “A Pipeline Becomes a Directed Map” with three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Every ML project needs a traceable path from source data to a monitored prediction.
explain_back_prompt: Using the “A Pipeline Becomes a Directed Map” story, explain Data → Model → Prediction without assuming the listener knows machine learning.
